title: Generic reusable-truth gate still admits empty producer output on real pricing proof
symptom: A real pricing producer finding from package job 7aeff7a8 remains seed-eligible under assess_reusable_truth(...) even though the verified_success row still carries pOutQuoteId = "" and later bounded pricing work required a stricter seed-trust gate to reject that shape.

trust_impact: The foundational truth-promotion layer is weaker than the bounded cluster seed gate, so later seeded rerun and convergence work would build on an inconsistent base.
allowed_next_actions: tighten assess_reusable_truth(...) so output-producing successes with empty or placeholder exported artifact slots are not seed-eligible without stronger corroboration
add a focused regression test using the real PR_BeginQuote finding shape from job 7aeff7a8
rerun the prompt-04 integrity truth challenge after the prompt-01 layer is repaired
disallowed_next_actions: continue to prompt 05 seeded reruns and convergence
treat the existing package carryover audit as sufficient evidence that the base is healthy
launch broader package or Batch B confirmation work on top of the current generic truth-promotion gate
exit_criteria: the real PR_BeginQuote finding shape from job 7aeff7a8 is no longer seed-eligible under assess_reusable_truth(...) without stronger corroboration
